findings.text: the declared 1e-6 psi_ZZ perturbation control copies the reference array, multiplies the copy by 1.000001 and compares it with that same reference, so its relative error is algebraically 1.000000e-6 and the assertion at :200 fails only if the threshold or relative() breaks; the measured route values are never perturbed, so a regressed psi_ZZ measurement path would still produce the same refusal, and inspect.py:90-96 repeats the same shape.

the gate runs inspect, limits and both report arms but never invokes document.py, so the evidence fragment that is the done_when deliverable is the one artefact no gate step regenerates or compares against receipt.json, and a later receipt re-run would leave it silently stale.

clearance() restates the point-to-segment distance loop that inspect.py:29-37 already computes for the same polygons, so the two files carry two copies of one geometric primitive that a shared helper would own.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit from 975f3e98cf to cc44a9229f; seven commits add 949 lines across inspect.py, limits.py, report.py, corners.py, document.py, gate.sh and the evidence fragment, all additive, with the receipt inputs pinned by SHA256 (report.py:185-190).
item_verdicts.done_when: the fragment docs/evidence/fragments/sub-millisecond-forward-path/bank-hessian-boundary.html:3 states the order-one error is not a source-boundary sampling artefact and cites the numerical receipt at :115; its quoted numbers reconcile with that receipt, but no gate assertion regenerates or checks it.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is to measure each retained Hessian route against the independent estimate separately at interior and at source-cell boundary nodes using one-sided limits; scripts/prototypes/bank_hessian_boundary/report.py:60-121 reports per-route interior errors and per-route lower/upper/average boundary errors for states 220, 333 and 336.
item_verdicts.manifest: read in full; it names the seven commits, the revision-pinned gate command, and the report-positive, report-negative and completion/measure, limits and split logs, all present on disk and ending EXIT=0 except report-negative.log which ends EXIT=1 as declared; it also records the two incomplete measurement attempts rather than presenting them as passing.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's declared paths and each of the seven commits; all seven changed paths (six files under scripts/prototypes/bank_hessian_boundary/ and the evidence fragment) lie inside the declared scope, and nothing outside it changed.

justifications.durability: no committed test reaches scripts/prototypes/bank_hessian_boundary, and the declared negative control at report.py:143-151 perturbs the reference array and compares it with itself, so no committed check reddens if the measurement path regresses.
justifications.evidence: docs/evidence/fragments/sub-millisecond-forward-path/bank-hessian-boundary.html:3 states the refutation over 64 interior and 92 boundary nodes and cites the receipt, whose recorded interior errors (0.557329 RZ, 0.265106 ZZ at state 220) match the table, though gate.sh:31-33 never regenerates the fragment.
justifications.fit: the drivers follow the neighbouring prototype idiom and import the owning helpers nova.biot.greens.second_moments and section_centroid (corners.py:12), ruff reports no finding over the six files, and the added identifiers carry no plan or ticket label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: scripts/prototypes/bank_hessian_boundary/report.py:78-121 emits the interior per-route discrepancy and the boundary lower/upper/average comparison for both routes at all three states, which is the goal's three clauses.
justifications.reuse: corners.py:12 extends nova.biot.greens rather than forking it and limits.py:18-20 reuses the referenced prototype, but limits.py:23-30 restates the point-to-segment clearance loop that inspect.py:29-37 already carries.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the 975f3e98cf..cc44a9229f diff sits inside the three declared write paths, and no plan, product source or test file is touched.
